vendors.name: JRDN at Tower23 Hotel
vendors.tagline: Modern surf and turf at the edge of the Pacific
vendors.description: JRDN is an upscale oceanfront restaurant and bar inside the Tower23 Hotel, steps from the sand in Pacific Beach. It serves contemporary seafood, sushi, and steakhouse fare with panoramic ocean views. The restaurant is open daily for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and weekend brunch.
vendors.hours: Breakfast Mon-Fri 9am-11am, Brunch Sat-Sun 9am-3pm, Lunch Mon-Fri 11am-3pm, Dinner Sun-Thu 5pm-9pm & Fri-Sat 5pm-10pm

events.title: IPAs by the Beach at JRDN
events.description: Tuesday afternoon IPA social at JRDN on the ground floor of Tower23. Hosted by Adrian and Marena Quijano: specifically focused on IPAs, not a general happy hour. A casual way to try what local and regional brewers are pouring without a set agenda.

events.title: JRDN Summer Wine Series: St. Supéry Estate
events.description: JRDN at Tower23 hosts St. Supéry Estate Vineyards & Winery for the Wednesday evening wine series. St. Supéry is a certified organic and sustainable Napa Valley producer. Guided tasting format with Mission Bay as the backdrop. Reservations required; check their Eventbrite for ticket price and availability.

events.title: JRDN Summer Wine Series: Austin Hope
events.description: JRDN Summer Wine Series with Austin Hope of Hope Family Wines, Paso Robles. Austin Hope is one of the more recognized names in California red blends and Rhône-style varietals. Guided tasting on the Tower23 ground floor with Mission Bay views. Reservations required.

events.title: JRDN Summer Wine Series: Darren Delmore & Tablas Creek
events.description: JRDN Summer Wine Series with Darren Delmore Wines and Tablas Creek. Tablas Creek is the Central Coast benchmark for Rhône producers; Darren Delmore's work there informs his own label. A solid double-bill for anyone interested in Paso Robles Rhône varieties.

events.title: JRDN Summer Wine Series: Curated Selections
events.description: JRDN Summer Wine Series with a curated selection from Vineyard Brands. The importer/distributor format covers multiple wineries in one evening rather than a single producer focus: broader sweep, less depth per label. Good if variety is the priority.

events.title: JRDN Summer Wine Series: Staff Picks Finale
events.description: JRDN Summer Wine Series finale: the Tower23 wine team selects what they've been pouring all summer. The most informal session of the run: no winery representative, just the staff talking through what they liked. Good close to the series.

vendors.name: The Collective
vendors.tagline: San Diego's premier private event space in the heart of Pacific Beach
vendors.description: The Collective is a bar and private event space on Garnet Ave in Pacific Beach, next door to and partnered with SD TapRoom, which supplies its beer and food. Most of the week it hosts birthdays, weddings, corporate events and fundraisers with bar or full catering service. It opens to the public Tuesday through Thursday for happy hour, Tuesday trivia, free Wednesday comedy and Thursday live music. 21+ and dog friendly.

vendors.name: Kate Sessions Memorial Park
vendors.tagline: 79-acre hilltop park on Mount Soledad with sweeping Mission Bay views

vendors.description: Ritual Wellness Collective is a breathwork, yoga, and meditation studio in Pacific Beach at 3510 Ingraham St, Suite 200. The women-owned and Latino-owned studio offers group classes, private sessions, and curated wellness events. Programming spans Kundalini and Vinyasa yoga, Yin, Reiki, sound baths, and structured breathwork.

events.title: Psychedelic Breathwork: Ritual Wellness
events.description: Guided psychedelic breathwork session with Ritual Wellness Collective at 3510 Ingraham St. Uses holotropic-style breathing to produce altered states without substances. Eye mask, music, facilitated integration session afterward. Pre-registration required; spaces are limited.

events.title: Sunday Ritual: Ritual Wellness Collective
events.description: Sunday morning wellness gathering from Ritual Wellness Collective at 3510 Ingraham St. Format varies by week: could be a breathwork session, sound bath, or guided meditation. Check their current Eventbrite listing for the specific format before going.

vendors.name: Pacific Beach Boardwalk
vendors.tagline: Beachfront path along Pacific Beach's Ocean Front Walk
vendors.description: The Pacific Beach Boardwalk, officially the Ocean Front Walk, is a flat concrete pathway running along the coastline from North Pacific Beach toward Mission Beach. It is a popular route for walking, running, biking, skateboarding, and rollerblading, lined with bars, restaurants, and shops. The busiest stretch is near Garnet Avenue and Crystal Pier.
vendors.address: Ocean Front Walk & Garnet Ave, San Diego, CA 92109
vendors.hours: Open daily

events.title: Pacific Beachfest
events.description: The neighborhood's largest annual event: a free family festival along the boardwalk with live music, local vendors, a kids zone, and community activities. Runs 9am-7pm. The Pacific Beach 5K runs on the sand and boardwalk as part of the same day.

events.title: Pacific Beach 5K
events.description: The 5K half of the Pacific Beach race weekend, run as part of Beachfest. The course is roughly half sand and half boardwalk, starting and finishing on the beach: an unusual surface mix that makes it slower than a road 5K. START TIME IS AN ESTIMATE: confirm with San Diego Running Co before the event.

vendors.name: 710 Beach Club
vendors.tagline: Pacific Beach's longest-running live music venue
vendors.description: 710 Beach Club is a breezy beachside bar, restaurant and concert stage at the foot of Garnet Ave, a fixture of PB nightlife since 1989. It books local bands on Saturdays, runs Wednesday open mic, Tuesday trivia and karaoke four nights a week, and serves a late-night menu daily from 8pm to 11pm. Daily deals include $10 lunches, Taco Tuesday and Friday happy hour, and weekend brunch brings $25 bottomless mimosas and frozen slushies. The dog-friendly patio overlooks the boardwalk; 21+ at night.
vendors.hours: Mon-Fri 11:30am-2am, Sat-Sun 10am-2am; late-night menu daily 8pm-11pm; brunch Sat-Sun 10am-2:30pm

events.title: Wednesday at 710 Beach Club: $10 Tenders & Half-Off Whiskey
events.description: $10 chicken tenders all day, $10 lunch menu 11:30am to 2pm, and 50% off select whiskey until 8pm. Industry Night from 8pm.

events.title: Open Mic Night at 710 Beach Club
events.description: Weekly Wednesday open mic: sign-ups at 6:30pm, show starts at 7pm. 710's Instagram also bills Wednesdays as a live band night. 21+.

events.title: Thursday at 710 Beach Club: $10 Spicy Chicken Sando
events.description: $10 spicy chicken sandwich all day, $10 lunch menu 11:30am to 2pm, and $7.10 bottled and draft beers and wine until 8pm. Karaoke at 8pm.

events.title: Karaoke Night at 710 Beach Club (Thursday)
events.description: Karaoke at 8pm every Tuesday, Thursday, Friday and Sunday at one of PB's favorite karaoke stages; this entry covers Thursdays. Late-night menu 8pm to 11pm. 21+.

events.title: Karaoke Night at 710 Beach Club (Friday)

events.title: Bottomless Brunch at 710 Beach Club (Saturday)
events.description: Weekend brunch 10am to 2:30pm with $25 bottomless mimosas, a $16 frozen slushie flight, the $19 Colossal Bloody and breakfast burritos, overlooking the boardwalk.

events.title: Live Music: Kassette at 710 Beach Club

events.title: Karaoke Night at 710 Beach Club (Sunday)

events.title: Monday at 710 Beach Club: $10 Pizzas & $7.10 Drinks
events.description: $10 cheese pizzas all day and night, $10 lunch menu 11:30am to 2pm, and $7.10 well liquor, bottled and draft beers until 8pm. Industry Night from 8pm with the late-night menu until 11pm.

events.title: Taco Tuesday at 710 Beach Club
events.description: Any 2 tacos for $10 and $7.10 margaritas, plus the $10 lunch menu 11:30am to 2pm. Trivia at 7pm, karaoke at 8pm.

events.title: Tuesday Trivia at 710 Beach Club
events.description: Weekly trivia night at 7pm on the boardwalk end of Garnet, with Taco Tuesday specials ($10 for any 2 tacos, $7.10 margaritas). Karaoke follows at 8pm.

events.title: Karaoke Night at 710 Beach Club (Tuesday)
events.description: Karaoke at 8pm every Tuesday, Thursday, Friday and Sunday at one of PB's favorite karaoke stages; this entry covers Tuesdays. Late-night menu 8pm to 11pm. 21+.

events.description: A three-band bill: The Neighbors bring punk influenced by Black Flag, Circle Jerks and the Sex Pistols, and Audrey is known for dynamic vocals and engaging live sets. Saturday live bands start at 9pm on 710's stage. 21+.

events.title: Live Music: PandEMOnium, Misery Loves Company, SAD & No Hard Feelings at 710 Beach Club
events.description: An emo and pop-punk nostalgia night built on heartbreak and raw emotion. Saturday live bands start at 9pm on 710's stage. 21+.

events.title: Live Music: Elyse Band & Sonafire at 710 Beach Club
events.description: Live rock double bill; Sonafire brings melodic songwriting and a live rock sound. Saturday live bands start at 9pm on 710's stage. 21+.

vendors.name: Pueblo
vendors.tagline: Modern Baja Coastal
vendors.description: Pueblo is a Pacific Beach restaurant serving modern Baja California coastal cuisine, located two blocks from the ocean. It opened in 2016 and emphasizes seafood, ceviches, street tacos and agave-based cocktails. Seating includes an open courtyard and a rooftop deck with two bars.
vendors.hours: Lunch daily 11:30am-4pm; Dinner Sun-Thu 4-9pm, Fri-Sat 4-10pm

events.title: PB Official Halloween Bar Crawl (PubCrawls.com)
events.description: PubCrawls.com's main Pacific Beach Halloween Bar Crawl on Halloween night. Starts at Pueblo at 3pm. Costume required for entry. Wristband access to all participating venues. This is the same company that runs the Oct 24 pre-Halloween crawl; the Oct 31 version is their primary event.

events.title: PB SantaCon Bar Crawl
events.description: PubCrawls.com's Pacific Beach SantaCon bar crawl, starting at Pueblo at 4pm on December 12. Come dressed as Santa, an elf, or anything holiday-themed: the sillier the better. Wristband access to multiple PB venues. One of the bigger non-Halloween crawl events of the year in the neighborhood.

events.title: Shoreline Business Connections
events.description: Wednesday morning B2B networking with TEAM Referral Network at San Diego Holistic Wellness in Pacific Beach. Structured referral format: members pitch their businesses and exchange leads. Better suited to established small business owners than casual attendees.

vendors.name: SD Mission Bay Boat & Ski Club
vendors.tagline: One of the oldest boating clubs in the nation
vendors.description: The San Diego Mission Bay Boat & Ski Club is a nonprofit waterfront social and boating club on Mission Bay. Its clubhouse includes a full bar, galley, conference hall, and outdoor event space. Members take part in water activities, social events, and charitable initiatives. Note: the club lists its address as 2606 N Mission Bay Dr.

events.description: Class of 1981 reunion for Mission Bay High School, open to classes of '80, '82, and '83. Hosted at the SD Mission Bay Boat & Ski Club on the water. Ticket required; check the Eventbrite for details on who organized it.

vendors.name: Revel Fit Club at MARA
vendors.tagline: A fully immersive boutique fitness experience
vendors.description: Revel Fit Club is a boutique fitness studio delivering strength, cardio, and HIIT in 50-minute group classes. Workouts pair high-intensity interval training on TechnoGym treadmills with strength work using the FitBench. The Pacific Beach studio is at 4275 Mission Bay Dr, Suite 110, with underground parking available.
vendors.address: 4275 Mission Bay Dr, San Diego, CA 92109

events.title: Breakaway + Revel Fit Club Run
events.description: Saturday morning run with Breakaway Run Club finishing at Revel Fit Club at MARA. Social run format: designed for people who want the run club experience without a competitive edge. Check their Eventbrite for the exact route and whether gear is needed.

vendors.name: Studio Golf San Diego
vendors.tagline: Not your typical golf club
vendors.description: Studio Golf San Diego is a membership-based indoor golf training facility at 4275 Mission Bay Dr. It is built around TrackMan simulators, PuttView putting technology, and Sportsbox AI 3D swing analysis, combining coaching, golf-specific fitness, custom club fitting, and members-only league nights. events.title: Industry Night at Studio Golf

vendors.name: Cafe of Life Chiropractic
vendors.tagline: For you and your family through every phase of life
vendors.description: Cafe of Life Chiropractic is a holistic family chiropractic practice in Pacific Beach at 4535 Fanuel St, founded by Dr. Stephanie Williams. The office specializes in pregnancy, pediatric, and family care, with all doctors Webster Certified. Techniques range from gentle, low-force adjustments to more traditional styles.

events.description: Baby brain development workshop with Dr. Stephanie Libs, DC at Cafe of Life Chiropractic in Pacific Beach. Covers infant neurological development and hands-on activities parents can use at home. Small group, morning format.

vendors.name: Hideaway Pacific Beach
vendors.tagline: Beach bungalow eats a block from Crystal Pier
vendors.description: Hideaway Pacific Beach is a beach bungalow restaurant and bar located a block from Crystal Pier in Pacific Beach. It features wood-fired pizza, cocktails and happy hour specials. The venue is open daily until 2am.
vendors.hours: Mon-Fri 11am-2am, Sat-Sun 9am-2am

events.title: Margaritas & Mingle: Founders Networking
events.description: Founders and entrepreneurs networking happy hour at Hideaway Pacific Beach, hosted by Brandon Fortino. Informal format: no presentations, no pitches, just drinks and conversation between people building things. Free to attend; drinks are your own tab.

vendors.name: Mindful Matters Counseling
vendors.tagline: Mindfulness-based therapy in Pacific Beach
vendors.description: Mindful Matters Counseling is the Pacific Beach practice of Marni Goldberg, LMFT, LPCC, offering individual, family, group, and teen therapy. The practice specializes in mindfulness-based approaches, cognitive-behavioral therapy, heart-centered hypnotherapy, and brainspotting. Sessions are available in person and online.

events.title: Escape to Relaxation: Mini Retreat

vendors.name: Shore Club
vendors.tagline: Sunsets served daily where Grand meets the sand
vendors.description: Shore Club is Pacific Beach's quintessential two-story beach bar at the foot of Grand Ave on the boardwalk, with panoramic ocean views, a beer garden and dozens of TVs. It serves Mexican-influenced seafood like fish tacos, breakfast until 2pm with the full menu all day, and is home of the RBV slushy. events.description: Stand-up comedy show at PorchLight Coffee from Banana Peel Productions. Small venue format: closer to a house show than a comedy club. Banana Peel runs these at rotating PB and beach-area spots. Check their Eventbrite for ticket price and door policy.

vendors.tagline: Home of the Buccaneers in Pacific Beach, San Diego Unified
vendors.description: Mission Bay High School is a public secondary school in the San Diego Unified School District, located at 2475 Grand Ave in Pacific Beach. Its mascot is the Buccaneer (Bucs). The school serves students in grades 9-12.
vendors.hours: Mon-Fri 8:00am-4:00pm

events.title: Screen Your Teen: Free Cardiac Screening
events.description: Free cardiac screening event for teenagers at Mission Bay High School, organized by the Eric Paredes Save A Life Foundation. Screens for hidden heart conditions that can go undetected until a cardiac event. No appointment needed; bring a parent or guardian.

vendors.name: PB Tuesday Farmers' Market
vendors.tagline: Fresh food, art, & air. See you on Tuesday!
vendors.description: The Pacific Beach Tuesday Farmers' Market is an outdoor certified farmers' market operating in Pacific Beach since 2011. It offers fresh produce, meats, cheeses, flowers, prepared foods, and handcrafted artisan works, and accepts EBT with Market Match benefits. The market runs weekly along Bayard Street between Garnet and Grand Avenues.
vendors.hours: Tuesdays 2:00pm-7:00pm

events.title: PB Tuesday Farmers' Market
events.description: The neighborhood's weekly certified farmers market, running rain or shine on Bayard and Hornblend. Produce, meat, cheese, eggs, bread, flowers, prepared food and craft vendors across two blocks. EBT accepted; the information booth converts benefits into market credit and there's a match program that adds free produce on top. Live music most weeks. HOURS: majority of sources say 2-7pm; the market's own website says 2-6pm. Confirm with the market manager at 858-273-3303.

vendors.name: Pacific Beach Town Council
vendors.tagline: Community advocacy and civic engagement for Pacific Beach
vendors.description: The Pacific Beach Town Council is a nonprofit community organization serving the Pacific Beach neighborhood of San Diego. It holds monthly general meetings, typically the third Wednesday of the month, and works on local civic issues and community events. Meetings are held at Crown Point Junior Music Academy (4033 Ingraham St).

events.title: Pacific Beach Town Council General Meeting
events.description: Monthly general meeting of the Pacific Beach Town Council, open to the whole neighborhood. The Town Council covers local issues and runs community programming including the summer concert series. Third Wednesday of every month. VENUE UNCONFIRMED: check pbtowncouncil.org for the current meeting location before pinning.

vendors.tagline: Be a Flamingo in a Flock of Pigeons
vendors.description: Flamingo Deck is a New American restaurant and bar with an Italian twist, located in the PB Promenade on Mission Blvd in Pacific Beach. It offers a rooftop dining experience steps from the water with brunch, lunch and dinner menus featuring pizza, pasta, seafood and steak, plus vegan-friendly options. Happy hour runs Monday through Friday.

vendors.description: Spice Lounge is an Indian restaurant and bar on Hornblend St in Pacific Beach, led by Chef Salwinder Singh Khinda, who cooked French and Italian cuisine in Europe for 30 years before opening in Southern California.
